lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The columns contain 5, 6, and 6 blobs respectively, forming a structured grid pattern on the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run dorso-ventrally, intersecting with the circular blobs to create distinct anchor nodes. These intersections are most visible in the first four bands posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge, running horizontally across the visible field.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6 to 8 small, low-contrast, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of sub-centimeter, high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial region, which transitions into the larger-scale grid pattern posterior to the gills.
